cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.summary: ES|QL: empty patterns in DISSECT command return empty attribute name and null value
cases.description:
```
ROW a="b c d"
| DISSECT a "%{b} %{} %{d}"
```
returns

```
       a       |       b       |               |       d       
---------------+---------------+---------------+---------------
b c d          |b              |null           |d 
```

it should ignore the empty pattern instead, and only return `a, b, d`

evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix DISSECT with empty patterns

Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/102577

Ignore empty DISSECT patterns, eg. `DISSECT a "%{a} %{} %{b}"` will only return two fields (`a` and `b`) and will ignore the empty pattern (discarding the corresponding values).
